title: alangium hollrungii
intro: Alangium hollrungii, commonly known as the East Indian alangium, is a plant species that belongs to the family Alangiaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Alangium hollrungii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Alangium hollrungii include its potential to reduce oxidative stress, improve immune function, and exhibit anti-cancer activities.
